public_inputs.calculation_spec: For each design hour compute residual_heat_kw_th=max(0, heat_load - heat_pump_heat - waste_heat). Size electric boiler input capacity as ceil((max residual heat)*(1+sizing_margin_fraction)/efficiency to capacity_increment_kw). Report feeder_peak_kw including non-boiler and heat-pump electric loads.

hard_constraints: Structured fields must match the independent calculation from public inputs.
